items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: The interviewee never mentions Bill Cray directly; the interviewer states 'I know Bill Cray used to tell me...', and the interviewee responds only to the interviewer's statement about Mike Trepanie and Joe Steve, without acknowledging or confirming any personal connection to Bill Cray.

ctx.x: Henry Wilde, he plays fine guitar.
I know his brother Bill too. He's a good bass player. Yeah, he's fine. Well, that Club Plantation must have been a good band.
Oh, that was a good band. Oh, that was a good band. That was with, you know, Raymond Boyk and Charlie DuPont. The piano man was, let's see. I could see him right in front of me.
